headline: Magna International Shuts Down Plants Due to Cybersecurity Breach
body: Magna International, a leading automotive parts manufacturer, has temporarily closed several of its production facilities following a cybersecurity breach that infiltrated its network systems. Efforts are underway to restore operations gradually. While there has been no report of a ransom demand, the company confirmed significant operational disruption. This incident highlights potential vulnerabilities in industrial cybersecurity and may cause ripple effects in the automotive supply chain.
